title: Regressor Instruction Manual
altTitles: 当反派拥有了全知属性
description: One day, Lee Kiyoung is suddenly summoned to another world where beasts are everywhere and an enormous crisis is approaching. His talent level is at rock bottom and almost all of his stats are hopeless. However, Kiyoung discovers that he can inspect the abilities and potential of others. Rather than relying on overwhelming strength, he uses his intelligence, manipulation, and every resource available to him—including powerful warriors, talented mages, and a mysterious regressor—to survive and climb to the top.
author: Wooden Spoon (Heulgsujeo) / Domi
